stem.en: A typo changes GAA to GAG. Kabir says "so the protein is broken". Both codons name glutamate. What happened?

text.en: Nothing. Same bead, same chain, same fold. The typo is silent, because the third letter is redundant for this bead.

feedback.en: The chain is identical. The tape changed and the protein did not.
One codon, one bead, one chain. The two codons are two spellings of the same word.
Some codons are read a little faster than others in some cells, but the chain is the same. Fold and job unchanged.

explanation.en: Look the codon up. If the bead is the same, the typo is silent. Redundancy at work.
